## Correction

Describe the narrow change and identify the affected record or reference.

## Reason

Explain the source-language, target-language, lexical, contextual, or textual
evidence supporting it.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I kept this change narrow and avoided unrelated formatting changes.
- [ ] I preserved reference, alignment, source text, and provenance fields
      unless the correction specifically concerns one of them.
- [ ] I validated the edited file's JSON or EDN syntax.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this wording under the repository license.
- [ ] I disclosed any material use of AI or machine translation and performed
      human review; none was used if I left it unstated.
- [ ] This pull request contains no credentials or private personal data.
